# R08 — four crossing corners and Q1 reservation study

Adds Q1 and both eastern 3×3 corner matrices to the R07 western assembly, using the recovered Q1 length 4032 and the previously read catalogue's four-corner rotational topology. The main width is 5866. No new archive scan, profile research or 3D generation is performed.

Q1 is the reflected N10 clear reservation at X3573–7605, Y±2933. Each eastern corner preserves the nine rectangular module combinations of 1152 / 1344 / 1536 with the selected 320 internal gaps. Two joined 640×320 strips reserve each crossing corner. Reflection is an experimental registration, not an assertion that these are approved saved-model coordinates.

The 800×320 exception stays at the two accepted N9/N10 junctions. No 800 allowance is silently assigned to Q1/Q2; that future receiving zone is excluded. All original R07 proxy geometries are retained exactly, and geometrically identical reservations are counted once.

The assembly has **145 clear reservations**, adding Q1 and eighteen eastern corner cells to R07's 126. All 36 cells in the four corner matrices preserve their original sizes. QA checks exact Q1 bounds; unchanged crossing bounds and all R07 geometries; valid polygons; unique IDs; and zero positive-area masonry intrusion. JSON round-tripped; the PNG is visually inspected separately. These checks concern technical and local 2D reservation geometry, not actual bearings, historical authenticity or structural adequacy.

The current user rule treats the full source dimensions as clear reservations, including clearance from shafts and bases. Source grids did not independently establish finished floor clearance. Original F5ZK-C/F5ZN-A geometry, the saved 14 ambulatory vaults, working generators, Pass 6J and V13 originals are untouched. This is not a master-model update. F5ZL-C supports remain unresolved.

The next substantive issue is the straight choir's width authority. Earlier MP-02 documentation describes taper toward the chevet, while the recovered F5ZE catalogue states constant 1152/1344/1536 lower modules. That catalogue's chevet branch is incompatible with protected F5ZN-A and cannot override it. Resolve the relevant saved approved choir plan before propagating an enlarged Q2–Q5 grid. The 29-unit junction discrepancy likewise remains unresolved. No source choice or chevet displacement is made here.

Other unfinished interfaces: Q1/Q2 receiving reservation; T2 transept arms; N1 westwork; exceptional chapels/buttresses; exterior wall closure around the crossing and transepts. No final cathedral extents are claimed.

Reproduce with `python build_east.py` (matplotlib, shapely). INPUT_R07.json bundles the parent geometry; CHECKPOINT.json contains exact native XY polygon coordinates and QA. Numerical scale is 1:1; physical metre conversion remains unresolved. Master Reference was recovered earlier in this ongoing workflow; no repeat governance read was necessary.
